result.instructions: Tools for Sesame HR, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who joined the company this month, and in which departments?"; "Which employees have pending absence requests for next week?"; "Show the worked hours of the Sales team for last month.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Sesame HR data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sesame_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sesame_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sesame_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. sesame_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sesame_token_info
tools.title: Show token info
tools.description: Show the company behind the API token: name, id, notification e-mail and language. Use it first to check the connection. Sesame API: GET /core/v3/info.

tools.name: sesame_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List employees of the company (active by default) with contact, job and organisation fields. Filter by e-mail, code, national id, department, office or entity group. Sesame API: GET /core/v3/employees.

code.description: Find an employee by employee code.

integrationCode.description: Find an employee by integration code (exact match).

dni.description: Find an employee by national id.

departmentIds.description: One or more ids; sent comma separated.

officeIds.description: One or more ids; sent comma separated.

entityGroupIds.description: One or more ids; sent comma separated.

orderBy.description: Sort, for example 'lastName asc' or 'createdAt desc'.

tools.name: sesame_get_employee
tools.title: Get an employee
tools.description: Get one employee by id, with the full profile. Sesame API: GET /core/v3/employees/{id}.

tools.name: sesame_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List the company departments, optionally filtered by name. Sesame API: GET /core/v3/departments.

orderBy.description: Sort, for example 'lastName asc' or 'createdAt desc'.

tools.name: sesame_list_offices
tools.title: List offices
tools.description: List the company offices with address and coordinates. Sesame API: GET /core/v3/offices.

orderBy.description: Sort, for example 'lastName asc' or 'createdAt desc'.

tools.name: sesame_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the company locations (geofenced places used for clock-in), with address, coordinates and radius. Sesame API: GET /core/v3/locations.

tools.name: sesame_list_roles
tools.title: List roles
tools.description: List the roles that can be assigned to employees. Sesame API: GET /core/v3/roles.

tools.name: sesame_list_entity_groups
tools.title: List entity groups
tools.description: List entity groups (teams or cost-centre groups), optionally for one employee or parent group. Sesame API: GET /core/v3/entity-groups.

tools.name: sesame_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: List the company custom fields (oldest first); option fields include their options. Sesame API: GET /core/v3/custom-fields.

orderBy.description: Sort, for example 'lastName asc' or 'createdAt desc'.

tools.name: sesame_list_job_charges
tools.title: List job charges
tools.description: List the job charge levels of the company. Sesame API: GET /core/v3/job-charges.

tools.name: sesame_list_work_entries
tools.title: List work entries
tools.description: List clock-in and clock-out work entries of the company or one employee, with worked and break seconds. Filter by date range. Sesame API: GET /schedule/v1/work-entries.

updatedAtFrom.description: Only entries updated at or after this ISO 8601 time (sync).

updatedAtTo.description: Only entries updated at or before this ISO 8601 time (sync).

orderBy.description: Sort, for example 'lastName asc' or 'createdAt desc'.

tools.name: sesame_list_check_incidences
tools.title: List check incidences
tools.description: List check incidences (attendance exceptions that need review), with status (pending or revised) and employee. Sesame API: GET /schedule/v1/check-incidences.

createdFrom.description: Created at or after this ISO 8601 time.

createdTo.description: Created at or before this ISO 8601 time.

orderBy.description: Sort, for example 'lastName asc' or 'createdAt desc'.

tools.name: sesame_list_worked_hours
tools.title: Worked hours report
tools.description: Report worked, due and balance seconds per employee for a date range. Sesame API: GET /schedule/v1/reports/worked-hours.

employeeIds.description: One or more ids; sent comma separated.

withChecks.description: Include check data in the totals.

tools.name: sesame_list_absence_requests
tools.title: List absence requests
tools.description: List absence day-off requests (leave other than vacation) with status, days and resolution. Filter by employee, dates or status. Sesame API: GET /schedule/v1/absence-day-off-requests.

fromDayOff.description: Days off from this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

toDayOff.description: Days off up to this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

orderBy.description: Sort, for example 'lastName asc' or 'createdAt desc'.

tools.name: sesame_list_vacation_requests
tools.title: List vacation requests
tools.description: List vacation day-off requests with status, days and resolution. Filter by employee, dates or status. Sesame API: GET /schedule/v1/vacation-day-off-requests.

fromDayOff.description: Days off from this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

toDayOff.description: Days off up to this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

orderBy.description: Sort, for example 'lastName asc' or 'createdAt desc'.

tools.name: sesame_list_vacation_calendars
tools.title: List vacation calendars
tools.description: List vacation calendars (one per employee and year) with the days off taken and the maximum allowed. Sesame API: GET /schedule/v1/vacation-calendars.

tools.name: sesame_list_shifts
tools.title: List shifts
tools.description: List the shift definitions of the company (name, colour, time ranges). Sesame API: GET /schedule/v1/shifts.

archived.description: true for archived shifts, false for active ones.

tools.name: sesame_list_shift_assignments
tools.title: List shift assignments
tools.description: List which shift each employee works on each date in a range (the planner). Sesame API: GET /schedule/v1/shift-assignments.

employeeIds.description: One or more ids; sent comma separated.

plannerIds.description: One or more ids; sent comma separated.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Sesame HR
prompts.description: What you can do with Sesame HR here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: look_up_employees_by_department_or_office
prompts.title: Look up employees by department or office
prompts.description: List active employees, filtered by department, office or entity group. Open one employee for the full profile.

prompts.name: review_pending_absence_and_vacation_requests
prompts.title: Review pending absence and vacation requests
prompts.description: List absence and vacation requests filtered by status. Then read the vacation calendar of each employee for the days taken and allowed.

prompts.name: report_worked_hours_for_a_date_range
prompts.title: Report worked hours for a date range
prompts.description: Report worked, due and balance seconds per employee for a date range. List the clock-in and clock-out entries behind the report.

prompts.name: find_attendance_exceptions_to_review
prompts.title: Find attendance exceptions to review
prompts.description: List check incidences that are pending or revised. Read the shift assignments for a date range to see the planned shifts.

prompts.name: confirm_the_connection_and_the_company_setup
prompts.title: Confirm the connection and the company setup
prompts.description: Show the company behind the API token. List the offices and the geofenced locations used for clock-in.
